physical-forms.name: Physical Forms
physical-forms.note: Source lists 35 entries for this table (one short of the 36 expected for a 6x6 grid). Preserved as-is rather than inventing a 36th entry; flagged here for transparency.

valuable-materials.name: Valuable Materials
